firstPlayerRule: Everyone makes their explore-or-return decision simultaneously. Choose a Guide, preferably someone who already knows the game, to coordinate play.
clarifications: The Guide prepares the round and signals when everyone reveals their decision. This role does not give that person an earlier decision than the other explorers.
